title: King Activity in the Endgame
description: In the endgame the king becomes a strong piece. Learn to activate and centralize your king to attack pawns and support your own.

sections.title: Centralize the King
sections.content: When the queens come off, rush the king toward the center. A centralized king influences both wings, attacks weak pawns, and shepherds passers. Do not leave it idle on the back rank.

positions.commentary: In a king-and-pawn endgame, the more active, centralized king usually wins. Race your king to the center and the key pawns.

sections.title: The King as Attacker
sections.content: An active king can win enemy pawns directly. While the opponent's king defends one weakness, yours marches in to capture another. Activity often outweighs a pawn.

positions.commentary: White's king heads to the queenside to attack the a7 pawn, exploiting its greater activity to win material.
hints: Send the king to the weak pawns

exercises.title: Race to the Center
exercises.description: White to play. Take the most active step toward the center with the king.
